description: Download assets for a single node: an exported render (`export`), the original images used as fills (`rawImages`, up to 20) and SVGs of the vector layers (`svgAssets`, up to 20). defaultFormat and defaultScale set the export format (png, jpg, svg, pdf) and scale (default png at 1).

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

name: download_assets
title: Download Assets
